attributes.name: Druva - Possible Administrator Impossible Travel
attributes.description: Detects the same administrator logging in from multiple reported locations within one hour. This is a proxy until proper GeoIP distance calculation is implemented.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.external_dependency: Threat intelligence / VPN-TOR enrichment; GeoIP/location enrichment
meta.customer_usecase: Detects the same administrator logging in from multiple reported locations within one hour. This is a proxy until proper GeoIP distance calculation is implemented.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
    AND druva.event_type == "Admin Login"

| EVAL admin = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )

| EVAL login_ip = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip),
    TO_STRING(source.ip)
  )

| EVAL location =
    TO_STRING(source.ip)

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| WHERE admin IS NOT NULL
    AND location IS NOT NULL

| STATS
    location_count =
      COUNT_DISTINCT(location),

    locations =
      VALUES(location),

    ip_addresses =
      VALUES(login_ip),

    first_login =
      MIN(event_time),

    last_login =
      MAX(event_time),

    first_location =
      FIRST(location, event_time),

    second_location =
      LAST(location, event_time),

    first_ip =
      FIRST(login_ip, event_time),

    second_ip =
      LAST(login_ip, event_time)

  BY admin

| WHERE location_count >= 2

| EVAL elapsed_minutes =
    DATE_DIFF(
      "minutes",
      first_login,
      last_login
    )

| WHERE elapsed_minutes <= 60
